{"metadata":{"description":"An omni-plugin for harness engineering workflows with multi-agents, programmatic gates and skills.","id":"gh:1174622182","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"mstar-harness","slug":"btspoony/mstar-harness","topics":["agent-plugin","dsh-plugin","harness-engineering","knowledge-management","multi-agent","omp-plugin","opencode-plugin","orchestration","sdd","spec-driven","subagents"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"An omni-plugin for harness engineering workflows with multi-agents, programmatic gates and skills."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Morning Star"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Harness Workflow Engine · Agent Plugin"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English / 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"GitHub · Issues"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[](https://github.com/btspoony/mstar-harness/releases) [](INSTALL.md#prerequisites)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Morning Star brings a delivery process to the AI coding tools you already use — dsh, omp, OpenCode, "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"Cursor, Kimi Code, ZCode, and Codex. You describe what you want; a `project-manager` agent clarifies"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" the request, keeps a plan, and carries the work from requirements through implementation, review, a"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"nd acceptance to a pull request. Requirements, architecture, implementation, review, acceptance, and"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" audits each go to a role that owns that part."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Why use it**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **From request to pull request** — describe the work once; the PM keeps the plan, brings in the ri"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ght specialists, and drives everything to a pull request. If work stops partway, the plan records wh"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ere it left off so the work can resume later.
- **Specialists instead of one long prompt** — a PM or"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"chestrates; separate roles own requirements, architecture, implementation, QC, acceptance, audits, a"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"nd ops, each with a narrow brief.
- **A trail you can audit** — plans, findings, review reports, and"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" decisions are recorded under the harness directory in your repo, not just in the chat."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Every host installs two ways: this CLI's `init` flow, or the host's own plugin manager — the native "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"command installs the plugin only. Options, path layout, and host notes: `INSTALL.md`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **dsh (DeepSeek Harness)** — needs the `dsh` CLI on `PATH`
- CLI: `npx @mstar-harness/cli init --t"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"arget dsh`
- Native: `dsh plugin --profile web add @mstar-harness/dsh`
- **omp** — needs the `omp` C"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"LI installed
- CLI: `npx @mstar-harness/cli init --target omp`
- Native: `omp plugin install @mstar-"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"harness/omp`
- **OpenCode**
- CLI: `npx @mstar-harness/cli init --target opencode`
- Native: `@mstar"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"-harness/opencode` for OpenCode 1.x, `@mstar-harness/opencode-v2` for OpenCode 2.x — add it to the p"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"lugin list in `opencode.json`, then restart OpenCode
- **Cursor** — needs `git`
- CLI: `npx @mstar-h"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"arness/cli init --target cursor`
- Native: `git clone https://github.com/btspoony/mstar-harness.git "},{"id":"p12s8","text":"~/.cursor/plugins/local/morning-star-harness`, then **Developer: Reload Window**
- **Kimi Code** — n"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"o CLI target
- Native: `/plugins install https://github.com/btspoony/mstar-harness`, then `/plugins "},{"id":"p12s10","text":"reload`
- **ZCode**
- CLI: `npx @mstar-harness/cli init --target zcode`
- Native: add `https://githu"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"b.com/btspoony/mstar-harness` as a ZCode plugin marketplace, then install **morning-star-harness**
-"},{"id":"p12s12","text":" **Codex** — needs the `codex` CLI
- CLI: `npx @mstar-harness/cli init --target codex`
- Native: `co"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"dex plugin marketplace add btspoony/mstar-harness --ref main`, then `codex plugin add morning-star-h"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"lace add btspoony/mstar-harness --ref main`, then `codex plugin add morning-star-harness@mstar-repo`"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Enter the PM once per session, then describe the work in your own words; the PM runs the process in "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"once per session, then describe the work in your own words; the PM runs the process in that session."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Host | Enter PM |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| dsh | `pm` skill |
| omp | `/skill:pm` |
| OpenCode | `Project Manager` agent, or `/pm` |
| Cursor"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" | `/pm` |
| Kimi Code | auto-loads in a session, or `/skill:pm` |
| ZCode | `/morning-star-harness:"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"pm` |
| Codex | `/pm` |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Single task (no iteration)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Give the PM a concrete request — for example, *"Add rate limiting to the public API and cover it wit"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"h tests."* The PM clarifies the gaps, writes a plan, runs the work on a feature branch, and drives i"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"t through implement → independent QC review → acceptance → done. Confirmed problems that are not fix"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ed in this round are captured as issues instead of being dropped. You review the result and merge."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Iteration"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Command | When |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `/iteration-start [direction] [pause]` | Phase 1: an interactive direction lock (grill-me) that pr"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"oduces the iteration's compass and plans, then continues automatically through execution, close, pul"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"l request, and merge-ready. `pause` stops after Phase 1; continue with `/iteration-drive`. |
| `/ite"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ration-drive` | Resume or advance an already locked iteration. Takes no arguments. |
| `/iteration-l"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"oop [direction] [scale]` | The same lifecycle end to end without the interactive phase. `scale` (`S`"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" / `M` / `L` / `XL`) caps how many plans the iteration takes on. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"An iteration ends only after its post-merge close: a closed phase, an open pull request, or a merged"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" pull request is not completion by itself. Command spelling differs per host — some hosts require a "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"plugin prefix, and Codex installs the command skills at project scope only; argument forms and per-h"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ost details are in `docs/commands.md`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Audit, review & verification"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Command | When |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `/codebase-audit [keywords]` | Read-only survey that produces prioritized, ready-to-execute improv"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ement plans; narrow it with a category focus (`bug`, `security`, `perf`, `tech-debt`, …). |
| `/amaz"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ing-pr-review [pr\|branch] [quick\|default\|deep]` | Pre-merge review of a PR or branch at three str"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"engths, ending in one verdict — `ship it`, `needs fixes`, or `blocked` from the finding tally on a s"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ettled run (completed without a stop, every required domain opened, the resolved diff basis readable"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" and complete), or the single derived `incomplete` on exactly three conditions — the run stopped bef"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"ore synthesis, a required domain seat never opened, or the resolved diff basis could not be read. A "},{"id":"p25s8","text":"wall-clock overrun is not one of them: a fully covered run past its budget publishes its tally-deriv"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"ed verdict and declares the overrun as a note. |
| `/amazing-test-audit [scope] [quick\|deep] [campa"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"ign]` | Read-only audit of the test surface → plans to delete, repair, consolidate, or relocate test"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"s. |
| `/amazing-e2e-check [environment] [scenarios]` | Runs browser, device, or installed-deploymen"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"t scenarios you explicitly asked for, in a separate workflow. |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The audit commands read and report; they do not edit your code. Two boundaries to know: `/amazing-pr"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"-review` posts its findings to GitHub as a comment review when you give it a pull-request number — i"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"t never approves, requests changes, or merges — and `/amazing-e2e-check` runs only when you ask for "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"it, with steps that touch a real environment requiring explicit authorization."}],"truncated":true}
